name: horizon
description: Horizon: local backend (backend/, FastAPI + SQLite) and app (frontend/). See README "Run locally".

scripts.setup: npm ci --no-audit --no-fund && npm ci --prefix frontend --no-audit --no-fund && uv sync --project backend
scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others --names api,web --prefix-colors blue,magenta "uv run --project backend horizon serve --reload" "npm run dev --prefix frontend -- --mode http"
scripts.demo: npm run build --prefix frontend -- --mode http && uv run --project backend horizon serve --static frontend/dist
scripts.test: uv run --project backend pytest -q && npm test --prefix frontend && npm run test:http --prefix frontend
